import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Set the style of the visualization
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a scatter plot to visualize the relationship between megapixels and price, colored by sensor type
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
scatter = sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='megapixels', y='price_usd', hue='sensor_type', style='has_video_4k', palette='deep', s=100, alpha=0.7)

# Add axis labels and title
scatter.set_xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=12)
scatter.set_ylabel('Price in USD', fontsize=12)
plt.title('Camera Megapixels vs Price by Sensor Type', fontsize=15)

# Add a legend
plt.legend(title='Sensor Type and 4K Video', title_fontsize='13', loc='upper left', bbox_to_anchor=(1, 1))
